blocks.text: Falkiyat mein sitaron aur kehkashaon tak faasle napna kainat ki banawat aur phailao samajhne ke liye zaruri hai.

blocks.title: Standard candles
blocks.text: Standard candles aise falkiyati ajsam hain jin ki asal chamak (luminosity) maloom hai aur jo falkiyati faasle napne ke auzaar hain.

Standard candle zameen se kitna roshan nazar aata hai (zahiri chamak) aur asal mein kitna roshan hai, in ka muqabla kar ke falkiyat-dan roshni ke inverse-square qanoon se us ka faasla nikal sakte hain: F = L/(4 pi d^2) se d = [L / (4 pi F)] ka square root. Standard candles ki misalein Cepheid variable sitare aur Type Ia supernovae hain, dono ki luminosity qabil-e-peshgoi hai jo unhein faasle ke qabil-e-aitbar nishan banati hai (Fig 21.2).

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Standard candles ka khayal 1910 ki dahai se hai, jab Henrietta Swan Leavitt ne daryaft kiya ke Cepheid variable sitare qabil-e-peshgoi andaz mein dhadakte (pulse) hain. Un ke kaam ne falkiyati faaslon aur kainat ke paimane ki paimaish ki bunyaad rakhi.

1.0 x 10^30 W luminosity wala Cepheid sitara zameen par 1.0 x 10^-12 W m^-2 flux deta hai. Is ka faasla maloom karein. Hal: d = [L / (4 pi F)] ka square root = [1.0 x 10^30 / (4 x 3.14 x 1.0 x 10^-12)] ka square root = (8.0 x 10^40) ka square root = 2.8 x 10^20 m (taqreeban 30 000 light-years).

blocks.prompt: Do sitare barabar roshan nazar aate hain. Aik standard candle hai jis ki asal chamak maloom hai; doosra nahi. Agar standard candle zyada door ho to doosre sitare ki asal chamak ke bare mein kya keh sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Doosra sitara qareeb hai lekin barabar roshan nazar aata hai, is liye standard candle se kam luminous hona chahiye (un ke faaslon ke tanasub ke square ke hisaab se).

items: Standard candles: maloom luminosity (Cepheids, Type Ia supernovae).
Naapa gaya flux aur F = L/(4 pi d^2) faasla dete.
